# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 38 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_038_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 38

**1** Jesus said: "You have wanted to hear what I'm telling you — many times over — and there is no one else you can hear it from.

**2** Days are coming when you will search for me and will not find me."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Wanted to hear... many times over" — the longing rendered as repeated desire
- "No one else you can hear it from" — the exclusivity made explicit
- "Days are coming" — future urgency emphasized
